name: read_diagnostics
description: Read bounded content-free diagnostics for the current session run, or with issues=true the grouped tool-failure issues of this conversation tree

run_id.description: Omit, leave empty, or use current for the active run; otherwise provide a known canonical run UUID from this session

issues.description: true: return grouped tool-failure issues instead — per group tool, error kind, message template, failed calls, retries, recoveries — plus the agent notes and agent-opened issues, and the artifact counts. Scope defaults to this conversation tree; an administrator may read the whole shared log.

scope.description: session (default): this conversation tree. all: the whole shared review log, administrators only

user_id.description: With scope all: only this account's runs; omit for every account

since.description: With scope all: Unix seconds; older runs are left out
